Bunsen-Burner.title: Bunsen Burner
Bunsen-Burner.tagline: Turn the heat up on your old tests.
Bunsen-Burner.description: A test framework for C# that turns arrange-act-assert into a composable pipeline, and disposes everything the arrange step created for you.

Cutout.title: Cutout
Cutout.tagline: Templating that costs nothing at runtime.
Cutout.description: A source generator that renders Liquid style templates into a StringBuilder at compile time, so generated code keeps its indentation without a template engine dependency.

Eon.title: Eon
Eon.tagline: Say when something should run, as data.
Eon.description: An immutable Schedule type: a potentially infinite stream of durations you can compose, iterate and await, with no execution engine attached.

Http-BuildR.title: Http BuildR
Http-BuildR.tagline: Requests and responses, without the framework.
Http-BuildR.description: A fluent builder for HttpRequestMessage and HttpResponseMessage built on System.Net.Http alone, with no dependencies and no extra allocations.

Icicle.title: Icicle
Icicle.tagline: Freeze a group of tasks into one unit of work.
Icicle.description: A TaskScope that runs related child tasks together, hands back a ResultHandle for each promised value, and succeeds or fails as a single unit.

Pasted.title: Pasted
Pasted.tagline: Text files, baked into the binary.
Pasted.description: A source generator that embeds the contents of text files into C# at compile time, for source generators and AOT apps where there is no filesystem at runtime.

Polyglot.Notebook.Docfx.Plugin.title: Polyglot Notebook docfx Plugin
Polyglot.Notebook.Docfx.Plugin.description: Renders Polyglot Notebook cells as docfx pages, supporting everything docfx markdown supports, and letting you hide setup cells from the output.

Tuxedo.title: Tuxedo
Tuxedo.tagline: Types that already know they are valid.
Tuxedo.description: A source generator that turns predicates into refined types, so a check made once carries its proof forward and never has to be repeated.

docfx.result-snippets.title: Docfx Result Snippets
docfx.result-snippets.tagline: Show what the code actually printed.
docfx.result-snippets.description: Saves the output of a method call to markdown, which a docfx page can include as a table, chart, class diagram or plain snippet.

Quacker.title: Quacker
Quacker.tagline: Duck typing, resolved at compile time.
Quacker.description: A source generator that specialises a generic method for every combination of argument types you actually call it with, so you can invoke members on a type parameter the compiler never had to know about.
